code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows severe hypoxemia and acidemia (low pH, low oxygen saturation/PaO2), leukopenia, anemia, thrombocytopenia, and abnormal white cell differential (low neutrophils/lymphocytes, high monocytes/basophils). Ferritin and INR are elevated. These findings suggest severe systemic illness, possibly sepsis or severe inflammatory response with respiratory failure and possible DIC. Immediate clinical correlation and urgent intervention are recommended.
